Field.Name: MsgType

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Indicates a message resent from the admin level (has a duplicate sequence number). Defaults to N.

Field.Name: SenderCompID

Field.Name: SendingTime

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: ID of destination. BATS for messages sent to BXE (BATS) ports. CHIX for messages sent to CXE (Chi-X) ports. (SenderCompID (49) for messages from BATS.)

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Sub ID of destination. TEST for messages sent to the BATS test system. PROD for messages sent to the BATS production system. (SenderSubID (50) for messages from BATS.)

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Possible resend flag. BATS has special handling for the PossResend for New Order Single messages. See New Order — Single below.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on messages to BATS. Must be identifier known to BATS. May be used by non-service bureau to specify which clearing arrangement to use if multiple are configured.

Field.Name: OnBehalfOfSubID
Field.Description: End-client sub identifier. Four characters, alphanumeric, otherwise not validated. Recorded and returned in DeliverToSubID (129). Available via Drop.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: For messages with PossDupFlag (43) = Y, indicates time that message was first sent. If enabled at the port or firm level, timestamps will be sent with microsecond resolution.

Field.Name: DeliverToCompID
Field.Description: Service bureau use. Identifies end-client on message from BATS. Must be BATS approved identifier.

Field.Name: DeliverToSubID

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Modulo 256 checksum of all characters in the message up to and including the delimiter preceding the CheckSum field. Three digits with leading zeroes if necessary.

Field.Name: Currency
Field.Description: Required if IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN). If Currency (15) is included when other symbology is used, it must match the currency expected by BATS for the given symbol.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Optional. Single value only (with no trailing space). The only valid value is: M = Midpoint (peg to midpoint of local book only) If set the LastPx is optional and is ignored. May not be used if specifying TransactTime.

Field.Name: IDSource
Field.Description: Values supported by BATS: 4 = ISIN 5 = RIC Required if Symbol (55) is not set.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this fill (zero for non-fills). May be excluded if using GrossTradeAmt.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Quantity of shares traded on this fill (zero for non-fills).

Field.Name: SecurityID
Field.Description: ISIN, or RIC if IDSource (22) is set.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Security symbol. See Symbology (p. 4) for additional notes.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Optional. Specifies the time at which the trade was arranged.

Field.Name: SettlType
Field.Description: Optional. Indicates settlement period. If present, SettlDate (64) over- rides this field. If SettlType (63) = 6, then SettlDate (64) is required. If both SettlType (63) and SettlDate (64) are omitted, the default value is 0 (Regular). Supported values: 0 = Regular (default) 6 = Future This field may not be amended.

Field.Name: SettlDate
Field.Description: Optional. Specifies the date on which the trade is desired to settle. If present, this field overrides SettlType (63). This field is required if the value of SettlType (63) = 6 (Future). This field may not be amended using our standard interface, but the ac- tual settlement date may be varied by the central counterparties (CCPs) due to operational requirements (eg. for symbols in a conditional trading status).

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Optional. Specifies the date on which the trade was arranged. If present, must be the current date and must must match the date component of TransactTime (60).

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Must be F = Trade

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Required when IDSource (22) = 4 (ISIN).

Field.Name: GrossTradeAmt
Field.Description: Total amount traded, expressed in units of currency. Only considered when LastPx is not specified.

Field.Name: TradeReportTransType
Field.Description: Specifies whether this trade report is new, a cancellation, an amend- ment or a release. Unilateral trades reported under the service may be cancelled or amended by the participant. Trades that are currently be- ing delayed from publication can be released for immediate publication. Defaults to ‘new’ if unspecified. 0 = New 1 = Cancel 2 = Replace 3 = Release

Field.Name: TradeReportID
Field.Description: Day-unique ID chosen by client. 20 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe. If the TradeReportID matches a live trade report (one that has been acked, but not confirmed or declined), it will be rejected as duplicate. Note: BATS only enforces the uniqueness of TradeRepor- tID values among currently live trade reports. However, we strongly recommend that you keep your TradeReportID val- ues day unique.

Field.Name: TradeReportRefID
Field.Description: Contains the TradeReportRefID (572) of the trade capture report ack that should now be withdrawn

Field.Name: MatchType
Field.Description: Where VenueType (1430) = O (offbook), this field models the MMT Level 2 ‘Trading Mode’ field, and must be 3 = Trade Reporting (On- Exchange).

Field.Name: SettlPrice
Field.Description: Optional. Price at which the price should settle at. If specified, any risk controls will be applied against this price. This field may not be amended.

Field.Name: TradeLinkID
Field.Description: Third Party Trade Identifier used for optional matching with counter- party. 30 characters or less. Characters in ASCII range 33–126 are allowed, except for comma, semicolon, and pipe.

Field.Name: TrdType
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.1 field ’Transaction Cate- gory’. 0 = Regular Trade (aka Plain-Vanilla Trade) 30 = Special price (aka Trade with Conditions) 61 = Give-up / Give-in trade 62 = Dark Trade 63 = Technical Trade

Field.Name: TrdSubType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.3 field ‘Crossing Trade Indicator’. Agency Cross trades may be indicated by setting Trd- SubType (829) = 37. Other values are invalid.

Field.Name: SecondaryTrdType
Field.Description: This optional field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.5 field ‘Benchmark Indicator’. Benchmark trades may be indicated by setting Secondary- TrdType (855) = 64. Other values are invalid.

Field.Name: TradeReportType
Field.Description: This field controls pending state of the trade report. 0 = (Submit) for all new trade reports 6 = (Trade Report Cancel) to cancel any acknowledged, but not con- firmed trade reports entered where TradeHandlingInst (1123) = 2

Field.Name: TradeID
Field.Description: Used to specify a previously reported trade to be amended or cancelled. Mandatory when TradeReportTransType (487) = 1, 2 or 3, must be absent when TradeReportTransType (487) = 0.

Field.Name: OrderCategory
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.2 field ’Negotiated Transac- tion Indicator’, and is used by the participant to indicate that the trade was a Negotiated Transaction as per the BATS Rules. For all trade reports reported on-exchange, the value must be 3. 3 = Privately Negotiated Trade

Field.Name: NoRootPartyIDs
Field.Description: When TradeHandlingInst (1123) = 0, must always be 1

Field.Name: RootPartyID
Field.Description: When TradeHandlingInst (1123) = 0, the third party responsible for submitting the pre-matched trade. Must be an identifier (4 uppercase letters) known to BATS.

Field.Name: RootPartyIDSource
Field.Description: When TradeHandlingInst (1123) = 0, must always be D (Proprietary / Custom Code)

Field.Name: RootPartyRole
Field.Description: When TradeHandlingInst (1123) = 0, specifies the role of the third party to the trade. At this time, only the following values are valid: 6 = IntroducingFirm

Field.Name: TradeHandlingInstr
Field.Description: Used to specify the trade reporting model used. 0 (Confirmed Trade) 1 (Two-Party Report) 2 (One Party Report for Matching)

Field.Name: TradePublishIndicator
Field.Description: This field corresponds to the MMT Level 4 field ’Publication Mode’, and is used by the participant to request that the publication be delayed. It is ignored if the trade does not qualify for delayed publication. This field may not be amended, however trades currently being delayed may be released prior to their maximum delay duration using TradeRe- portTransType (487) = 3. Supported values: 0 = Do Not Publish 1 = Publish trade (immediately) 2 = Deferred Publication When using TradeHandlingInstr (1123) = 2, the only acceptable value is TradePublishIndicator (1390) = 0.

Field.Name: VenueType
Field.Description: Must be O = OffBook. This field models the MMT Level 1 field ‘Market Mechanism’.

Field.Name: NoTradePriceConditions
Field.Description: Optional. If present, must have the value 1, and indicates the presence of a single TradePriceCondition (1839) field.

Field.Name: TradePriceCondition
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate that the ex/cum dividend state of the trade. This field corresponds to the MMT Level 3.6 ‘Ex/Cum Dividend Indi- cator’. Supported values are: 0 = Cum Dividend 2 = Ex Dividend

Field.Name: ExecMethod
Field.Description: Optional. Used to indicate that the method by which the trade was ex- ecuted. This field corresponds to the proposed MMT Level 3.7 ‘Offbook Automated Liquidity Indicator’. The following values are supported: 0 = Unspecified (default) 1 = Manual 2 = Automated

Field.Name: Tolerance
Field.Description: Maximum allowed delta (in terms of consideration, expressed in the traded currency), that the trade is prepared to match against coun- terparty.
